findings: Excluded local checks made the simulated complete lifecycle73 seconds despite60 second cap.
Exited client leader suppressed group cleanup.
Previously hashed bytes remained accepted after a simulated surviving writer changed the exact-length payload during group cleanup.

reviewed_contract.scope: One public package684 checksum source /RHUH-GBM-nii-v1.sums; no patient images.
reviewed_contract.source_and_auth: Metadata requests are fixed public collection/configuration/authorization/token/one-path transfer-spec operations. Resolved source mapping is digest-pinned; host,ports,cipher,direction and token authentication fail closed. No account credentials inspected.
reviewed_contract.local_dependencies: Binary, bundled license and IBM-published shared bootstrap key are hash-bound; executable signature, key permissions and ignored nonsymlink quarantine path checked before authorization. This review exercises mocked local provenance refusals, not a new key or binary acquisition.
reviewed_contract.credentials: Fresh public authorization/token/cookie remain in memory or restricted client environment; no secret argv, saved specification, raw exception/client output or inherited Aspera/SSH credentials.
reviewed_contract.byte_bound: OS RLIMIT_FSIZE65536; only one regular61787-byte file can be accepted. Payload and receipt readback are bounded and use O_NOFOLLOW. Owner test actually verifies an inert local child cannot write65537 bytes.
reviewed_contract.time_and_cleanup: Supervisor starts before checks, gives worker up to57 seconds, kills group unconditionally and reaps at most1 second.59-second outer watchdog includes final readback/summary and exits124 on timeout. A remaining group after worker success rejects acceptance; final payload is independently reconciled only after no group remains. Logical-clock/handler controls passed; no live transfer timing claim.
reviewed_contract.attempts: One direct ascp invocation and no application-level retry; no ascli retry wrapper. Protocol packet retransmission and undocumented client internals are not claimed to be disabled or experimentally verified.
reviewed_contract.acceptance: Parent accepted=true is required; worker receipt alone is provisional. Client failure, timeout, surviving writer, malformed/partial file, and stale hash remain unaccepted. Exact length plus a local SHA256 is not an independent publisher digest for the checksum file.

limitations: Successful provider transfer remains unexecuted and requires separate root release.
No content parsing, dataset scientific quality, image transfer or clinical validation is implied.
